summary: FAIL on one Medium, mandatory-violation finding. F-DG0-204: a finding's verification is not bound to the run that verified it. The F-DG0-201 binding covers reviews and audits but not verifications (rules.mjs:417), which contradicts agents.md/D-016. My round-1 findings F-DG0-201, 202 and 203 are independently verified as fixed (CLOSED_VERIFIED). All seven assigned commands pass on the frozen candidate. The register and both coverage matrices are exactly complete. All ten agents loaded as distinct invocations on the orchestrator's model, with out-of-scope writes blocked (re-verified live). A01-A28 are all feasibly assigned. Three Low observations (F-DG0-205, 206, 207) I would accept as observations.
